status: preregistered synthetic crop-model-v3 target-routing software fixture; candidate not run
classification: Synthetic software invariant only. This fixture checks target-qualified automatic-harvest routing and payout replay at a frozen source-thermal maturity endpoint; it is not crop-accuracy, natural harvest-date, measured-trial, reference-model, or predictive evidence.

sourceBoundary.thermalReference: Andrews et al., OSU Extension EM 9305, Tomato degree-days, Table 6 (four cultivars; 1844–2010 °F·days).
sourceBoundary.sourceLicenseOrReuse: No open license identified in the source artifact; cite and retain only derived parameter values, with no text/code reproduction.
sourceBoundary.sourceUse: Frozen crop identity and source thermal thresholds keep all seven cells on the same reducer maturity endpoint. No tomato cultivar equivalence or biological maturity claim is made.
sourceBoundary.syntheticInputs: Soil, daily environment, production parameters, establishment state, target layout, and payout scenario are synthetic. The synthetic soil source tag must be unknown.
missingInputs: Measured local weather and soil profile

cropParameters.rootZoneEvidenceCitation: Synthetic software acceptance fixture; no biological claim

establishment.cells: The same frozen establishment values are applied to all seven target-qualified cell keys.

dailyEnvironment.dateRule: Consecutive UTC dates from 2026-10-01 through the first day after the no-auto-harvest maturity endpoint.
dailyEnvironment.endpointRule: The endpoint is the first no-auto-harvest reducer tick on which biomassFrac is 1 for each of the seven registered keys. The fixture checks payout routing on this reducer endpoint, not whether its date is biologically accurate.

expected.payoutFormulaKgPerCell: 12 g DM/m² × 0.4² m²/cell × 0.5 harvest index / 1000 g/kg
expected.harvestDay: The actual source-thermal maturity endpoint determined from the frozen no-auto-harvest baseline.

eventTargetPayloadContract: Floor event.target is omitted to preserve the legacy x,y event payload; elevated events include {kind: growing-level, growingSpaceId: space-a, levelId: high}. The typed event comment is reconciled to this existing runtime behavior without changing event generation.

acceptanceChecks.frozenDispatchAndInputs: Assert crop-model-v3/run-inputs-v3/crop-parameters-v4, seven frozen crop/establishment entries on the exact registered target keys, source soil tag unknown, synthetic production/root-zone values, and no ordinary new-run default change.
acceptanceChecks.endpointAndTargetRouting: At the first no-auto-harvest maturity endpoint, require exactly seven auto-harvest events with the exact registered unique cell-key set, one event per key, no target field on the floor event (legacy contract), the exact growing-level target on each elevated event, and matching endpoint dayIndex.
acceptanceChecks.payoutAndSummary: Require each event payout within 1e-12 kg of 0.00096 kg and the unrounded seven-event sum within 1e-12 kg of 0.00672 kg; require exactly 0.01 kg total and crop-1 summaries.
acceptanceChecks.nextDayNoDuplicate: The fixture includes the consecutive following environment day and requires no second payout event for any key.
acceptanceChecks.matureState: Each of the seven final target-qualified cells is mature, ready on the endpoint, and harvested; target-qualified siblings remain independently addressable.
acceptanceChecks.deterministicReplay: Repeat simulateRun from the same frozen RunConfig and environment series; events, final cells, and summary must match exactly.

toleranceReview.rationale: The bound covers only JavaScript double-precision multiplication, division, and seven-event summation for the frozen arithmetic. Target keys, target references, event count, event dates, duplicate suppression, rounded summaries, frozen identities, and replay equality are exact structural assertions. This is not a biological, source-parameter, calibration, measurement, or model-error tolerance.
